detector.description: Alerts when number of detectors is projected to reach the limit in next 48 hours
detector.name: Splunk Operational - Number of detectors is expected to reach the limit
detector.programText:
from signalfx.detectors.countdown import countdown
A = data('sf.org.limit.detector', rollup='latest').max().max(over='1d').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('sf.org.num.detector', filter=filter('purpose', 'CUSTOM'), rollup='latest').max().max(over='1d').publish(label='B', enable=False)
F = (B/A*100).publish(label='F')
countdown.hours_left_stream_incr_detector(stream=F, maximum_capacity=100, lower_threshold=48, fire_lasting=lasting('12h', 0.8), clear_threshold=96, clear_lasting=lasting('12h', 0.8), use_double_ewma=False, auto_resolve_after='4h').publish('Splunk Operational - Number of detectors is expected to reach the limit')

rules.description: The signal % Detector Limit Used (assumed to be increasing) is projected to increase to 100 in 48 hour(s).
rules.detectLabel: Splunk Operational - Number of detectors is expected to reach the limit
